#### Fermi-GBM trigger 816807700: a localized but still unclassified gamma-ray candidate

Fermi-GBM triggered at **2026-11-19 19:01:35.03 UTC**. A human-reviewed final-position Notice was issued at **2026-11-20 01:44:43 UTC**, placing the event at **RA 14.527°, Dec +33.090° (J2000)** with a **13.43° statistical error radius**. The Notice gives the localization energy range as **50–300 keV**. [Fermi-GBM Notice](https://gcn.gsfc.nasa.gov/other/816807700.fermi); [public GBM trigger table](https://gcn.gsfc.nasa.gov/gcn/fermi_grbs.html).

The event remains a **gamma-ray-transient candidate**, not a confirmed GRB or source association. The final Notice does not provide a long/short classification, duration, fluence, detection significance, systematic localization term, or astrophysical false-alarm probability. No GCN Circular, retraction, refined classification, or independently reported counterpart was present by the **20 November 07:14:31 UTC** source cutoff. The public Swift/BAT targeted-search portal had registered the trigger but still listed the analysis products as pending, so it does not provide a BAT detection or non-detection. [Swift/BAT targeted-search entry](https://guano.swift.psu.edu/).
